items.name: Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc0ppIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7074cb88987f8a1665e68652fe09ce8f6b104f3b/image.png) Ξεκινά η συναρπαστική σειρά των διαγωνισμών για το 2024 με το 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024', τον πρώτο διαγωνισμό της χρονιάς, αφιερωμένο στους νέους λάτρεις του cubing! Με μεγάλη χαρά και ενθουσιασμό ανοίγουμε την αυλαία για μια σειρά από διαγωνισμούς, όπου νέοι συμμετέχοντες θα έχουν την ευκαιρία να αναδείξουν το ταλέντο και την αγάπη τους για το cubing. Το 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024' θα είναι μια πρώτη ευκαιρία για τους νέους cubers να γευτούν την μαγεία του ανταγωνισμού και να γνωρίσουν την κοινότητα από κοντά. Μην χάσετε την ευκαιρία να γίνετε μέρος αυτής της μοναδικής εμπειρίας. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε για την πρόκληση και ελάτε να γιορτάσουμε μαζί το πάθος για το cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) The exciting series of competitions for 2024 begins with the 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024', the first competition of the year, dedicated to new "cubing enthusiasts"! With great joy and excitement, we open the curtain on a series of competitions where new participants will have the opportunity to showcase their talent and love for cubing. The 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024' will be a first chance for them to taste the magic of competition and get to know the community up close. Don't miss the chance to be a part of this unique experience. Grab your cubes, get ready for the challenge and come celebrate the passion for cubing together! Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.name: Franconia First Timers 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc0phIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--757a22c30b75dcff95194ffd68cb7c180c714d6e/WCA%20Newcomer%20Month%20LOGO_A1.jpg) This edition of the Franconia competitions is participating **in the official WCA Newcomer Month** and is especially directed towards new and inexperienced competitors. Furthermore it is a series competition with Franconia Winter 2024. Competitors can register either only for this competition or only for Franconia Winter 2024. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Further information on the acceptance of registrations can be found in the tab "Newcomer Month". Diese Ausgabe der Franconia-Competition **im Rahmen des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month** richtet sich insbesondere an neue und unerfahrene Cuber. Sie ist außerdem Partner-Competition von Franconia Winter 2024. Teilnehmer können sich entweder nur für diesen Wettkampf oder nur für Franconia Winter 2024 anmelden. Bei der Anmeldung werden 50% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmende reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmende gelten Teilnehmer:innen ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2024. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmende haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2023 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmenden müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt. Weitere Informationen zur Annahme der Anmeldungen findet ihr im Tab "Newcomer Month".

items.name: French FMC Championship 2024
items.information: Merci de **lire attentivement les conditions d'inscription, la [FAQ](#34417-faq) et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. Pensez également à consulter l'onglet [Planning](#competition-schedule). **ATTENTION** Cette compétition n'est PAS une compétition classique. Il n'y aura qu'une seule épreuve : la résolution optimisée (Fewest Moves), pendant laquelle la solution la plus courte à un mélange donné doit être trouvée et écrite sur une feuille en un temps maximum d'une heure. **Il n'y aura pas de 3x3 classique lors de cette compétition.** ---- Please **read the registration conditions, the [FAQ](#34417-faq) et the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**. Make sure to read the [Schedule](#competition-schedule) tab. **WARNING** This competition is NOT a regular competition. There will be only one event: Fewest Moves, in which the shortest solution to a given scramble must be found and written on a sheet of paper in a maximum of one hour. **There will be no 3x3 in this competition.**

items.name: German Newcomer Day 2024
items.information: **English** **This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024.** The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. **Registrations will be accepted based on the following:** * 60 spots (50% of spots) are initially reserved for new competitors. * 60 spots (50% of spots) are initially are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If more than 60 new competitors register before 60 spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the 60 spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. **Deutsch** **Dieser Wettbewerb ist Teil des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month 2024.** Bei der Anmeldung werden 50% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmer reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmer gelten Teilnehmer ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2024. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmer haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2023 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmer müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt. **Anmeldungen werden nach folgenden Kriterien angenommen:** * 60 Plätze (50% der Plätze) sind zunächst für neue Teilnehmer reserviert. * 60 Plätze (50% der Plätze) sind zunächst für wiederkehrende Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" verfügbar. * Wenn sich mehr als 60 neue Teilnehmer anmelden, bevor die 60 Plätze von den zurückgekehrten Teilnehmern besetzt sind, werden alle weiteren neuen Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" zusammen mit den wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern zugelassen. * Wenn die 60 für neue Teilnehmer reservierten Plätze zwei Wochen vor dem Wettbewerb nicht durch neue Teilnehmer besetzt sind, werden die verbleibenden Plätze bis zum Teilnehmerlimit den bereits registrierten Teilnehmern zugewiesen.

items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.name: New-Cumberland County 2024
items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1019092248614424637/1182038138156232814/WCA_Newcomer_Month_LOGO_A1_12.png?ex=65833dcd&is=6570c8cd&hm=8601e1d3b9f4839c2e67ef9936687a271a917d082791b5a0fbd068754df11b32&) This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will reserve 25% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: * 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * Initially, 75% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If greater than 25% of new competitors register before 75% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

items.information: ![This competition is in partnership with West Coast Cubing, LLC](https://i.imgur.com/jmSpkQE.png) * Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors. **Competition Day Timing** - The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. - Lunch will end at the scheduled time. - Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called. #### **How to Withdraw/Alter Registration** Registered competitors withdraw/alter their registration by emailing the organisation team (unrcubing@gmail.com) the following: 1. Statement of intent to withdraw/alter registration. 2. Changes to registration (if appplicable). 3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor. #### **Check-In** Competitors will receive a name tag. #### **Staff Member Registration** Competition staff members are hand-selected by the organisation team and will be offered a refunded registration fee in exchange for their service to the cubing community for the entire duration of the competition.

items.information: All competitors should read the Competitor Responsibilities tab before registering **How to Change/Cancel Your Registration** Competitors can change or cancel by emailing the organization team with the following information: 1. Intent to change/cancel registration 2. Desired changes to registration 3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor. Competitors can also modify their registration through the Register tab. In the event that a competitor cancels their registration, they will only receive a 75% refund ($18.75 USD). The deadline to change/cancel your registration is March 1st , 2024, 6:00 PM Mountain Time. **Waitlist Procedure** If registration fills up, we will place competitors on a waitlist. In the event a competitor drops from the competition, competitors will be accepted from the waitlist in the order we receive payment. Competitors can be accepted from the waitlist until March 1st at 6:00 PM MST. You will receive a full refund if you are still on the waitlist by then.
